run_slurm_sweep: run a hyperparameter sweep across a grid of configs using SLURM batch jobs
copy_python_snapshot: copy all Python files from a source directory into a timestamped snapshot for reproducibility
generate_train_command: generate the training command with distributed settings, save directory, and hyperparameter CLI args
generate_sbatch_command: generate an sbatch command string with GPU, node, partition, and memory constraints for SLURM
check_job_status: check whether a training job in a save directory has finished, failed, or already started
